verdict.rationale: Gitleaks provides a documented configuration format (gitleaks.toml) for writing custom regex-based detection rules, plus composite rules combining primary and required auxiliary rules for more complex organizational secret formats, and supports specifying custom config paths via GITLEAKS_CONFIG. missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of writing a custom rule end-to-end and detecting an org-specific token format, and more detail on rule schema/testing tooling.
